question: Does BGPTunnel.com still offer the free IPv4 and IPv6 GRE transit it advertised in 2026-10, and what account, ASN or address-space prerequisite does it require today?
why: The bgptunnel.com landing page now shows only an iFog GmbH VPS advertisement, so the former first-party statement of free GRE transit is no longer present; the ASN requirement is still named only by tunnelbroker.services.
